page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, no margin notes. Page number at top left, running head at top centre. Catchword at bottom right.

main_text.p: go in intimo sinu magno, peninsulæ similis. Cervix enim eam à continente separabat lata xxv stadia. Ab ea cervice lingua quadam oblonga, semistadium lata, excurrebat versus occidentem inter stagnum & mare, rupibus undique munita, & muro simplice. Versus meridiem & continentem, ubi etiam Byrsa erat in cervice, murus triplex erat, altus xxx cubitos absque propugnaculis & turribus, qua binorum jugerum spacijs inter se distabant per circuitum, nixa fundamentis xxx pedum, singulæ contignationum quatuor. Muri vero ad secundam contignationem pertingebant. Erant autem fornicati & capaces, in quorum infima parte ccc elephanti stabulabantur, adjunctis pabuli promptuariis. Superius erant quatuor millium equorum stabula cum hordei penuariis. Virorum quoque diversoria xx millium peditum, quatuor millium equitum. Tantus apparatus bellicus ordinarium locum habebat in solis mœnibus. Angulus autem, qui ab hoc muro præter dictam linguam ad portus flectebatur, solus erat debilis & humilis, neglectus à principio. Hi portus sic erant dispositi, ut navigatio esset ex alio in alium, & ab alto unum commune os patebat latum pedes lxx, quod claudebatur catenis ferreis. Pri-

page.notes: Faint marks at the lower left ("COMMOD", repeated) look like show-through or stains and were left out. Red stains at the left edge and bottom left were left out. The catchword "mus" is the start of the next page's word "Primus", so the paragraph ends on "Pri-". The initial word "go" is a fragment carried over from the previous page. The "à" in "à continente" is written as a plain a with an accent-like mark and may be a printer's variant; please check it against the scan.
